lines.text: So, you've pulled something in your leg?
Back of my right thigh, sprinting for a bus on Friday.
I felt a pop, and it bruised the next day, all the way down to the knee.
Let me have a look. Straight leg raise is about half the other side, and it's sore when you push your heel back into my hand.
I think you have a moderate hamstring strain, so no running for at least three weeks.
Lie on your back with your heel on a chair and lift your bottom off the floor, ten slow lifts, twice a day.
Is that all? I thought you'd give me something harder.
That's plenty for now, honestly. Right, cheerio, see you in a fortnight, mind the stairs on the way out.
Mrs Kowalski, hello there, lovely weather, isn't it?
Hello! Gorgeous, isn't it. I hope you can help, my wrist has been clicking and aching since I took up knitting.
Ah, a knitter! Let's hear all about it.
